issue.title: ImportError on master: _subprocess.py imports the now-private stream_and_parse_messages_json_output
issue.description:
`import sase.llm_provider` raises ImportError at master HEAD 4d36d6d3d, which breaks pytest collection repo-wide (every tests/monitor node errors, and any module importing sase.llm_provider fails).

REPRODUCTION (clean tree, no local diff):
  .venv/bin/python -c 'import sase.llm_provider'
  File 'src/sase/llm_provider/_subprocess.py', line 12, in <module>
    from ._subprocess_claude import stream_and_parse_messages_json_output
  ImportError: cannot import name 'stream_and_parse_messages_json_output' from 'sase.llm_provider._subprocess_claude'

ROOT CAUSE: a semantic conflict between two independently landed commits. c1970b5a0 ('fix(llm_provider): make stream_and_parse_messages_json_output private', the fix for task sase-ld) renamed the function to `_stream_and_parse_messages_json_output` and updated every caller. Commit 4d36d6d3d ('feat: normalize Grok tool-call stream artifacts') was developed on a tree predating that rename and re-added `from ._subprocess_claude import stream_and_parse_messages_json_output` at _subprocess.py:12. `git blame -L 12,12 src/sase/llm_provider/_subprocess.py` attributes the line to 4d36d6d3d; `grep '^def ' src/sase/llm_provider/_subprocess_claude.py` shows only the private name exists. Neither commit is broken alone; the merge is.

SCOPE: decide whether 4d36d6d3d's new code actually needs that symbol. If it calls it, import the private name (`from ._subprocess_claude import _stream_and_parse_messages_json_output`) or re-promote the function to public and drop the sase-ld symvision finding; if nothing in 4d36d6d3d uses it, delete the stale import line. Check `__all__` / the private re-export in _subprocess.py either way, and confirm `just check` lint (symvision) still passes, since sase-ld was filed precisely because the public name was unused. Verified locally that aliasing the private name makes the import succeed and tests/monitor go 119 passed.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ld — closed task whose fix (c1970b5a0) made the symbol private; this regression is that rename colliding with concurrently-landed 4d36d6d3d, not a defect in sase-ld's fix. Do not simply revert sase-ld: its symvision lint finding will return.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced after just install while splitting tests/monitor/test_monitor_store.py: all 28 affected tests collected, then every node failed in the shared _clear_config_caches fixture because src/sase/llm_provider/_subprocess.py imports the absent public stream_and_parse_messages_json_output. Current source and HEAD both define only _stream_and_parse_messages_json_output, confirming the failure is unrelated to the test-only split.
